notes: Fake Your Own Death, printed: 'Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."' The creature that comes back is a new object (CR 400.7): it has neither the +2/+0 nor the granted ability. Seat 0's 2/2 dies once (returns, one Treasure) and is then dealt 2 damage again the same turn: it dies for good, stays in the graveyard, and no second Treasure appears.
